parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.  
Certain reserved keywords such as SYS and root cannot be used
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号名称。  
不能使用某些预留关键字，如 SYS、root 等
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the user. Valid values:  

Normal: standard account.
Admin: superuser account.
ReadonlyAccount: read-only account. Only MySQL tenants support read-only accounts
parameters.help_zh:
用户类型。  

Normal：普通账户。
Admin：超级账户。
ReadonlyAccount：只读账户，仅 MySQL 租户包含只读账户
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The password must be 10 to 32 characters in length. Special characters include: !@#$%^*()_+-=
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号访问密码。
必须包含大写英文字符、小写英文字符、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为 10-32 位； 特殊字符为：!@#$%^*()_+-=
parameters.name: user_password

parameters.help_en:
The role information of the user. For standard users, specify the account information as a JSON-formatted character string. The value is an array that contains Database (MySQL pattern) information and role information (Role). Roles include the following types: Read and write permission (ReadWrite): ALL PRIVILEGES. Read-only permission (ReadOnly): SELECT. DDL permission (DDL): CREATE, DROP, ALTER, SHOW VIEW, CREATE VIEW. DML permission: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW. DML permission (DML): SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW.
  • Oracle pattern: leave this parameter empty.
  • MySQL pattern: the superuser account has ALL PRIVILEGES by default. Leave this parameter empty.
parameters.help_zh:
用户的角色信息。 普通用户填写账户的信息，其为 JSON 格式的字符串，默认为一个数组，数组内包含 Database（MySQL 模式）信息和角色信息（Role）。角色包含以下几类： 读写权限（ReadWrite）：ALL PRIVILEGES。 只读权限（ReadOnly）：SELECT。 DDL 权限（DDL）：CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW。 DML 权限：SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW。 DML 权限（DML）：SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW。
  • Oracle 模式：无需填写。
  • MySQL 模式：超级账户默认为 ALL PRIVILEGES，无需填写。
parameters.name: roles

TenantUser.description_en: The list of database accounts in the tenant
TenantUser.description_zh: 租户中的数据库账号列表信息

Roles.description_en: The role permission information of the account
Roles.description_zh: 账户对应的角色权限信息

Role.description_en:
The role that is granted. 
Oracle mode: roles are at the schema level and include the following types: 
ReadWrite: read and write permissions, including CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE PROCEDURE, CREATE SYNONYM, CREATE SEQUENCE, CREATE TRIGGER, CREATE TYPE, CREATE SESSION EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE, CREATE ANY OUTLINE, ALTER ANY OUTLINE, DROP ANY OUTLINE, CREATE ANY PROCEDURE, ALTER ANY PROCEDURE, DROP ANY PROCEDURE, CREATE ANY SEQUENCE, ALTER ANY SEQUENCE, DROP ANY SEQUENCE, CREATE ANY TYPE, ALTER ANY TYPE, DROP ANY TYPE SYSKM, CREATE ANY TRIGGER, ALTER ANY TRIGGER, DROP ANY TRIGGER, CREATE PROFILE, ALTER PROFILE, DROP PROFILE.
ReadOnly: read-only permissions, SELECT.
MySQL mode: roles are at the database level and include the following types:
ReadWrite: read and write permissions, including ALL PRIVILEGES.
ReadOnly: read-only permissions, including SELECT.
DDL: DDL permissions, including CREATE, DROP, ALTER, SHOW VIEW, CREATE VIEW.
DML: DML permissions, including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW.
Oracle accounts have default read and write permissions on their own schemas. These permissions are not listed here
Role.description_zh:
拥有的角色。 
Oracle 模式，角色为 Schema 级别，其可分为 
ReadWrite：读写权限，包括 CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE PROCEDURE, CREATE SYNONYM, CREATE SEQUENCE, CREATE TRIGGER, CREATE TYPE, CREATE SESSION EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE, CREATE ANY OUTLINE, ALTER ANY OUTLINE, DROP ANY OUTLINE, CREATE ANY PROCEDURE, ALTER ANY PROCEDURE, DROP ANY PROCEDURE, CREATE ANY SEQUENCE, ALTER ANY SEQUENCE, DROP ANY SEQUENCE, CREATE ANY TYPE, ALTER ANY TYPE, DROP ANY TYPE SYSKM, CREATE ANY TRIGGER, ALTER ANY TRIGGER, DROP ANY TRIGGER, CREATE PROFILE, ALTER PROFILE, DROP PROFILE；
ReadOnly：只读权限，SELECT。
MySQL 模式，角色为数据库（Database）级别，其包括以下几类：
ReadWrite：读写权限，包括 ALL PRIVILEGES。
ReadOnly：只读权限，包括 SELECT。
DDL：DDL 权限，包括 CREATE, DROP, ALTER, SHOW VIEW, CREATE VIEW。
DML：DML 权限，包括 SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW。
Oracle 账户对自己的 Schema 有默认的读写权限，此处不会列出
Role.title_zh:
拥有的角色。 对于Oracle模式，角色为schema级别，其可分为 - ReadWrite：读写权限，包括CREATE TABLE CREATE VIEW CREATE PROCEDURE CREATE SYNONYM CREATE SEQUENCE CREATE TRIGGER CREATE TYPE CREATE SESSION EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY OUTLINE ALTER ANY OUTLINE DROP ANY OUTLINE CREATE ANY PROCEDURE ALTER ANY PROCEDURE DROP ANY PROCEDURE CREATE ANY SEQUENCE ALTER ANY SEQUENCE DROP ANY SEQUENCE CREATE ANY TYPE ALTER ANY TYPE DROP ANY TYPE SYSKM CREATE ANY TRIGGER ALTER ANY TRIGGER DROP ANY TRIGGER CREATE PROFILE ALTER PROFILE DROP PROFILE； - ReadOnly：只读权限，SELECT
对于MySQL模式，角色为数据库（Database）级别，其有以下几类： - ReadWrite：读写权限，包括ALL PRIVILEGES； - ReadOnly：只读权限，包括SELECT - DDL: DDL权限，包括CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW - DML: DML权限，包括SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW。
另外Oracle账户对自己的schema有默认的读写权限，这里不会列出。

Roles.title_zh: 账户对应的角色权限信息

UserStatus.description_en:

ONLINE: unlocked.

UserStatus.description_zh:

LOCKED：锁定。
ONLINE：解锁。
创建完成的账户默认状态为 ONLINE
UserStatus.title_zh: 数据库账号的状态。 - Locked：锁定 - ONLINE：解锁 创建完的账户默认为ONLINE状态
